240: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
241:                      uint32_t *order)
242: {
243:   uint32_t wire[2];
244:   int ret;
245: 
246:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
247:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
248:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
249:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
250:   if (ret == OK)
251:     {
252:       *order = ++g_send_order;
253:       g_stats.tx++;
254:     }
255:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
256:     {
257:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
258:     }
259: 
260:   if (ret < 0)
261:     {
262:       g_stats.last_tx_error = (uint32_t)(-ret);
263:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
264:         (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
265:         ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
266:         ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
267:         ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
268:     }
269: 
270:   return ret;
271: }

308: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
309:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
310:                                  int result)
311: {
312:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;
313: 
314:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
315:     {
316:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
317:       channel->queued = false;
318:       channel->result = result;
319:     }
320: 
321:   if (active->callback != NULL)
322:     {
323:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
324:     }
325: 
326:   active->busy = false;
327:   if (result == OK)
328:     {
329:       release_acks_before(active->order);
330:     }

364: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
365: {
366:   unsigned int i;
367:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
368: 
369:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
370:     {
371:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
372:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
373:         {
374:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
375:           g_recovery_index = i;
376:           break;
377:         }
378:     }
379: 
380:   if (epoch == NULL)
381:     {
382:       uint32_t newest = 0;
383: 
384:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
385:         {
386:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
387:             {
388:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
389:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
390:               g_recovery_index = i;
391:             }
392:         }
393: 
394:       epoch->replay = true;
395:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
396:     }
397:   else
398:     {
399:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
400:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
401:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
402:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
403:     }
404: 
405:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
406:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
407:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
408:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
409:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
410: }

412: static void begin_abort(int result)
413: {
414:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
415: 
416:   if (g_active.busy)
417:     {
418:       g_active.quarantine = true;
419:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
420:     }
421: 
422:   if (probe != NULL)
423:     {
424:       probe->quarantine = true;
425:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
426:     }
427: 
428:   fail_pending(result);
429:   g_probe_requested = false;
430:   select_recovery_epoch();
431: }

436: 
437:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
438:     {
439:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)

450: static int dispatch_locked(void)
451: {
452:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
453:   struct active_transaction *active;
454:   struct logical_channel *channel;
455:   unsigned int i;
456:   int ret;
457: 
458:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
459: 
460:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
461:     {
462:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
463:         {
464:           continue;
465:         }
466: 
467:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
468:       if (ret < 0)
469:         {
470:           return ret;
471:         }
472: 
473:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
474:     }
475: 
476:   if (g_reset_pending)
477:     {
478:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
479:       if (ret < 0)
480:         {
481:           return ret;
482:         }
483: 
484:       g_reset_pending = false;
485:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
486:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
487:     }
488: 
489:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
490:     {
491:       return OK;
492:     }
493: 
494:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
495:     {
496:       channel = &g_channels[i];
497:       if (!channel->queued)
498:         {
499:           continue;
500:         }
501: 
502:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
503:         {
504:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
505:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
506:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
507:             {
508:               continue;
509:             }
510: 
511:           active = &epoch->probe;
512:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
513:             {
514:               return -ENOLINK;
515:             }
516:         }
517:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
518:         {
519:           active = &g_active;
520:           if (active->quarantine)
521:             {
522:               return -ENOLINK;
523:             }
524:         }
525:       else
526:         {
527:           return OK;
528:         }
529: 
530:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
531:         {
532:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
533:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
534:                  sizeof(active->message));
535:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
536:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
537:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
538:             g_channel_ids[i]);
539:         }
540: 
541:       active->callback = channel->callback;
542:       active->arg = channel->arg;
543:       active->channel_index = i;
544:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
545:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
546:       if (ret < 0)
547:         {
548:           return ret;
549:         }
550: 
551:       active->busy = true;
552:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
553:         {
554:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
555:             {
556:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
557:             }
558: 
559:           g_probe_attempts++;
560:           g_stats.probes++;
561:         }
562: 
563:       return OK;
564:     }
565: 
566:   return OK;
567: }

569: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
570:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
571:   const struct active_transaction *active)
572: {
573:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
574:   uint32_t reason = 0;
575: 
576:   if (!active->busy)
577:     {
578:       return 1u;
579:     }
580: 
581:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
582:     {
583:       reason |= 2u;
584:     }
585:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
586:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
587:     {
588:       reason |= 4u;
589:     }
590:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
591:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
592:     {
593:       reason |= 8u;
594:     }
595:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
596:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
597:     {
598:       reason |= 16u;
599:     }
600: 
601:   return reason;
602: }

604: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
605: {
606:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
607:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
608:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
609: }
610: 
611: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
612: {
613:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
614:   struct active_transaction *active;
615:   bool replay;
616:   int result;
617:   uint32_t reason;
618: 
619:   active = busy_probe();
620:   if (active == NULL)
621:     {
622:       active = &g_active;
623:     }
624: 
625:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
626:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
627:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
628:   if (reason != 0)
629:     {
630:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
631:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
632:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, g_stats.last_ack_header);
633:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, g_stats.last_active_header);
634:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
635:       return;
636:     }
637: 
638:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
639:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
640:     {
641:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
642: 
643:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
644:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
645:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
646:       return;
647:     }
648: 
649:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
650:     {
651:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
652:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
653:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
654:       return;
655:     }
656: 
657:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
658:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
659: 
660:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
661:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
662:     {
663:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
664:     }
665: 
666:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
667:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
668:   if (replay)
669:     {
670:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
671:       unsigned int i;
672: 
673:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
674:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
675:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
676:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
677:        */
678: 
679:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
680:       g_active.quarantine = false;
681:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
682:         {
683:           if (i != replay_index)
684:             {
685:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
686:             }
687:         }
688: 
689:       select_recovery_epoch();
690:       (void)dispatch_locked();
691:       return;
692:     }
693: 
694:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
695: 
696:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
697:     {
698:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
699:         {
700:           release_recovery_slots();
701:           g_recovery_index = 0;
702:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
703:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
704:         }
705:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
706:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
707:         {
708:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
709:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
710:            */
711:         }
712:       else
713:         {
714:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
715:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
716:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
717:         }
718:     }
719: 
720:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
721:            result < 0)
722:     {
723:       begin_abort(result);
724:     }
725: 
726:   (void)dispatch_locked();
727: }

729: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
730: {
731:   struct ack_slot *slot;
732:   unsigned int rx_index;
733:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
734:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
735:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
736:   uint8_t state = 0;
737:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
738: 
739:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
740: 
741:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
742:     {
743:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
744:       if (slot == NULL)
745:         {
746:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
747:           return -EAGAIN;
748:         }
749:     }
750:   else
751:     {
752:       slot = NULL;
753:     }
754: 
755:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
756:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
757:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
758:     {
759:       g_stats.bad_header++;
760:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
761:     }
762:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
763:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
764:     {
765:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
766:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
767:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
768:         {
769:           if (slot != NULL)
770:             {
771:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
772:             }
773: 
774:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
775:           return -EAGAIN;
776:         }
777:       else if (ret < 0)
778:         {
779:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
780:         }
781:     }
782:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
783:     {
784:       g_pwc_rx(message);
785:       ret = OK;
786:     }
787:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
788:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
789:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
790:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
791:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
792:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
793:     {
794:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
795:       ack_flags = 2u;
796:       ret = OK;
797:     }
798:   else
799:     {
800:       g_stats.unsupported++;
801:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
802:     }
803: 
804:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
805:     {
806:       return OK;
807:     }
808: 
809:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
810:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
811:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
812:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 MBOX0 v2 physical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <string.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
13: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
14: 
15: #include "arm_internal.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
18: #include "bk7258_boottrace.h"
19: #include "irq.h"
20: 
21: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)
22: #define MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET   8u
23: 
24: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
25: {
26:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
27:   uint32_t order;
28:   bool used;
29: };
30: 
31: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
32: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
33: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
34: static uint32_t g_processing_order;
35: static bool g_mbox_ready;
36: static bool g_mbox_smp_ready;
37: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
38: 
39: static void mbox_trace_errors(void)
40: {
41:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(4,
42:     (g_stats.bad_source & 0xffu) |
43:     ((g_stats.bad_length & 0xffu) << 8) |
44:     ((g_stats.bad_address & 0xffu) << 16) |
45:     ((g_stats.descriptor_full & 0xffu) << 24));
46: }
47: 
48: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
49:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");
50: 
51: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
52: {
53:   return getreg32(up_cpu_index() == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
54:                                        BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS);
55: }
56: 
57: static void mbox_clear_errors(int cpu)
58: {
59:   uintptr_t cfg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG;
60:   uint32_t config = getreg32(cfg);
61:   uint32_t errors = config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
62: 
63:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
64:     {
65:       g_stats.write_error++;
66:     }
67: 
68:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
69:     {
70:       g_stats.read_error++;
71:     }
72: 
73:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
74:     {
75:       g_stats.write_full++;
76:     }
77: 
78:   if (errors != 0)
79:     {
80:       putreg32((config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, cfg);
81:     }
82: }
83: 
84: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
85:                                 uint32_t length)
86: {
87:   if (source != 0)
88:     {
89:       g_stats.bad_source++;
90:       mbox_trace_errors();
91:       return false;
92:     }
93: 
94:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
95:     {
96:       g_stats.bad_length++;
97:       mbox_trace_errors();
98:       return false;
99:     }
100: 
101:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
102:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
103:     {
104:       g_stats.bad_address++;
105:       mbox_trace_errors();
106:       return false;
107:     }
108: 
109:   return true;
110: }
111: 
112: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
113: {
114:   uintptr_t status;
115:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
116: 
117:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
118:     {
119:       return -EINVAL;
120:     }
121: 
122: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
123:   if (cpu == 1 && (destination != 1 || data[1] != 0))
124:     {
125:       return -EPERM;
126:     }
127: #endif
128: 
129:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
130:    * receive FIFO status register.
131:    */
132: 
133:   status = destination == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
134:             destination == 1 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
135:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
136:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
137:     {
138:       return -EAGAIN;
139:     }
140: 
141:   putreg32(data[0], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA0 :
142:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA0);
143:   putreg32(data[1], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 :
144:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA1);
145:   putreg32(destination, cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TID :
146:                                   BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TID);
147:   return OK;
148: }

150: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
151: {
152:   unsigned int i;
153: 
154:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
155:     {
156:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
157:         {
158:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
159:         }
160:     }
161: 
162:   return NULL;
163: }
164: 
165: static bool mbox_priority_message(
166:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
167: {
168:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
169: 
170:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
171: }
172: 
173: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
174: {
175:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
176:   unsigned int i;
177: 
178:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
179:     {
180:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
181: 
182:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
183:         {
184:           continue;
185:         }
186: 
187:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
188:         {
189:           oldest = desc;
190:         }
191:     }
192: 
193:   return oldest;
194: }
195: 
196: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
197: {
198:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
199:   int ret;
200: 
201:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
202:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
203:    */
204: 
205:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
206:     {
207:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
208:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
209:       g_processing_order = 0;
210:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
211:         {
212:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
213:           break;
214:         }
215: 
216:       desc->used = false;
217:     }
218: 
219:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
220:     {
221:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
222:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
223:       g_processing_order = 0;
224:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
225:         {
226:           break;
227:         }
228: 
229:       desc->used = false;
230:     }
231: }
232: 
233: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
234: {
235:   uintptr_t rdata0;
236:   uintptr_t rdata1;
237:   uintptr_t sidreg;
238:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
239:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
240: 
241:   (void)irq;
242:   (void)context;
243:   (void)arg;
244: 
245:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
246:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
247:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
248:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
249:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
250:     {
251:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
252:     }
253:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
254:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
255:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
256: 
257:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
258:     {
259:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
260:       uint32_t address;
261:       uint32_t length;
262:       uint8_t source;
263: 
264:       if (cpu == 0)
265:         {
266:           mbox_process_desc();
267:         }
268: 
269:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
270:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
271:         {
272:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
273:           mbox_trace_errors();
274:           break;
275:         }
276: 
277:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
278:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
279:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
280: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
281:       if (length == 0)
282:         {
283:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
284:             {
285:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
286:                 {
287:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
288:                 }
289: 
290:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
291:             }
292:           else
293:             {
294:               if (cpu == 0)
295:                 {
296:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
297:                   mbox_trace_errors();
298:                 }
299:             }
300: 
301:           continue;
302:         }
303: #endif
304: 
305:       if (cpu != 0)
306:         {
307:           continue;
308:         }
309: 
310:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
311:         {
312:           continue;
313:         }
314: 
315:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
316:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
317:              sizeof(desc->message));
318:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
319:       desc->used = true;
320:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
321:       mbox_process_desc();
322:     }
323: 
324:   if (cpu == 0)
325:     {
326:       mbox_process_desc();
327:     }
328: 
329:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() ==
330:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW)
331:     {
332:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_EXIT);
333:     }
334: 
335:   return OK;
336: }
337: 
338: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
339: {
340:   g_callback = callback;
341: }
342: 
343: void bk7258_mbox_kick_rx(void)
344: {
345:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
346: 
347:   (void)bk7258_mbox_irq(0, NULL, NULL);
348:   up_irq_restore(flags);
349: }
350: 
351: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
352: {
353:   unsigned int i;
354: 
355:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
356:     {
357:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
358:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
359:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
360:         {
361:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
362:         }
363:     }
364: }
365: 
366: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
367: {
368:   irqstate_t flags;
369: 
370:   if (stats == NULL)
371:     {
372:       return;
373:     }
374: 
375:   flags = up_irq_save();
376:   *stats = g_stats;
377:   up_irq_restore(flags);
378: }
379: 
380: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
381: {
382:   int ret;
383: 
384:   if (g_mbox_ready)
385:     {
386:       return OK;
387:     }
388: 
389:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
390:   g_rx_order = 0;
391:   g_processing_order = 0;
392:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
393: 
394:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
395:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
396:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
397:    */
398: 
399:   putreg32(2u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
400:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
401:             BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
402:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
403: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
404:   putreg32(5u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
405:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
406:             BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG);
407:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH2_FIFO_CFG);
408: #endif
409:   modifyreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
410:   mbox_clear_errors(0);
411: 
412:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
413:   if (ret < 0)
414:     {
415:       return ret;
416:     }
417: 
418:   g_mbox_ready = true;
419: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
420:   g_mbox_smp_ready = true;
421: #endif
422:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
423:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
424:   return OK;
425: }
426: 
427: bool bk7258_mbox_smp_ready(void)
428: {
429: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
430:   return g_mbox_ready && g_mbox_smp_ready;
431: #else
432:   return false;
433: #endif
434: }
435: 
436: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
437: int bk7258_mbox_secondary_init(void)
438: {
439:   if (!g_mbox_ready || !g_mbox_smp_ready || up_cpu_index() != 1)
440:     {
441:       return -EAGAIN;
442:     }
443: 
444:   mbox_clear_errors(1);
445:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
446:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
447:   return OK;
448: }
449: #endif

35: #define MB_UART_RTS_ASSERT    BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE

109: _Static_assert(MB_UART_TX_SIZE > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE &&

111:                "mailbox UART TX ring index does not fit uint16_t");

114:                "mailbox UART RX ring index does not fit uint16_t");

116: static uint16_t ring_count(uint16_t read_index, uint16_t write_index,
117:                            uint16_t size)
118: {
119:   return write_index >= read_index ? write_index - read_index :
120:          size - read_index + write_index;
121: }

123: static uint16_t tx_count(void)
124: {
125:   return ring_count(g_uart.tx_read, g_uart.tx_write, MB_UART_TX_SIZE);
126: }

128: static uint16_t rx_count(void)
129: {
130:   return ring_count(g_uart.rx_read, g_uart.rx_write, MB_UART_RX_SIZE);
131: }

133: static uint16_t tx_free(void)
134: {
135:   return MB_UART_TX_SIZE - tx_count() - 1u;
136: }

138: static uint16_t rx_free(void)
139: {
140:   return MB_UART_RX_CAPACITY - rx_count();
141: }

143: static void update_local_rts(void)
144: {
145:   bool new_rts = g_uart.upper_rts || rx_free() <= MB_UART_RTS_ASSERT;
146: 
147:   if (new_rts != g_uart.local_rts)
148:     {
149:       g_uart.local_rts = new_rts;
150:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
151:       if (new_rts)
152:         {
153:           g_uart.stats.rts_assert++;
154:         }
155:       else
156:         {
157:           g_uart.stats.rts_release++;
158:         }
159:     }
160: }

162: static bool valid_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack)
163: {
164:   return ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
165:          ack->payload_length == 0 && ack->flags == 0 && ack->crc8 == 0 &&
166:          ack->reserved == 0;
167: }
168: 
169: static void mb_uart_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
170:                                 int result, void *arg)
171: {
172:   irqstate_t flags;
173:   uint8_t command;
174:   bool failed;
175: 
176:   (void)arg;
177:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
178:   command = ack == NULL ? g_uart.transaction_command :
179:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(ack);
180:   failed = result < 0 || !valid_ack(ack) ||
181:            (ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & 2u) != 0);
182: 
183:   if (ack != NULL && valid_ack(ack))
184:     {
185:       g_uart.peer_rts = (ack->payload_address & 1u) != 0;
186:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
187:     }
188: 
189:   if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
190:     {
191:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = false;
192:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
193:     }
194: 
195:   if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && g_uart.tx_inflight != 0)
196:     {
197:       if (!failed)
198:         {
199:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
200:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
201:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
202:         }
203:       else if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
204:         {
205:           /* A failed/unknown ACK cannot tell whether CP consumed the bytes.
206:            * Drop this local chunk rather than replaying terminal characters.
207:            */
208: 
209:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
210:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
211:           g_uart.stats.tx_unknown++;
212:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
213:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
214:         }
215:       else
216:         {
217:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
218:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
219:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)
220:             {
221:               /* Keep tx_read unchanged.  The same chunk may be copied again
222:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.
223:                */
224: 
225:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 1;
226:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry++;
227:             }
228:           else
229:             {
230:               g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
231:                                MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
232:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
233:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry_drop++;
234:             }
235:         }
236: 
237:       g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;
238:     }
239:   else if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE && failed)
240:     {
241:       g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
242:       /* The transport invokes this completion before it changes READY to
243:        * ABORTING.  Always retain a STATE request so RESET recovery has a
244:        * probe to send after it reaches PROBING.
245:        */
246: 
247:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
248:     }
249: 
250:   g_uart.transaction_busy = false;
251:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
252:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
253: }

255: static int mb_uart_receive(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
256:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
257: {
258:   uint8_t command = bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message);
259:   uint16_t length = message->payload_length;
260:   uint16_t first;
261:   bool failed = false;
262:   bool malformed = false;
263: 
264:   (void)arg;
265:   if (ack_flags == NULL)
266:     {
267:       return -EINVAL;
268:     }
269: 
270:   if (command != BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && command != BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
271:     {
272:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
273:       failed = true;
274:       malformed = true;
275:     }
276:   else if ((message->flags & ~1u) != 0)
277:     {
278:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
279:       failed = true;
280:       malformed = true;
281:     }
282:   else if (message->crc8 != 0)
283:     {
284:       g_uart.stats.bad_crc++;
285:       g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_PARITY;
286:       failed = true;
287:       malformed = true;
288:     }
289:   else if (message->reserved != 0)
290:     {
291:       g_uart.stats.bad_reserved++;
292:       failed = true;
293:       malformed = true;
294:     }
295: 
296:   if (!failed && command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA)
297:     {
298:       if (message->payload_address != BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS)
299:         {
300:           g_uart.stats.bad_pointer++;
301:           failed = true;
302:           malformed = true;
303:         }
304:       else if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
305:         {
306:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
307:           failed = true;
308:           malformed = true;
309:         }
310:       else if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
311:         {
312:           failed = true;
313:         }
314:       else if (rx_free() < length)
315:         {
316:           g_uart.stats.rx_overflow++;
317:           g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_OVF;
318:           failed = true;
319:         }
320:       else
321:         {
322:           const uint8_t *source =
323:             (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS;
324: 
325:           __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
326:           first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_write;
327:           if (first > length)
328:             {
329:               first = length;
330:             }
331: 
332:           memcpy(&g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_write], source, first);
333:           if (first != length)
334:             {
335:               memcpy(g_uart.rx_ring, source + first, length - first);
336:             }
337: 
338:           g_uart.rx_write = (g_uart.rx_write + length) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
339:           g_uart.stats.data_rx++;
340:           g_uart.stats.rx_bytes += length;
341:         }
342:     }
343:   else if (!failed)
344:     {
345:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
346:         {
347:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
348:           failed = true;
349:           malformed = true;
350:         }
351:       else
352:         {
353:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
354:         }
355:     }
356: 
357:   if (!malformed)
358:     {
359:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
360: 
361:       g_uart.peer_rts = (message->flags & 1u) != 0;
362:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
363:       if (old_peer_rts && !g_uart.peer_rts)
364:         {
365:           nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
366:         }
367:     }
368: 
369:   update_local_rts();
370:   *ack_flags = (g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u) | (failed ? 2u : 0u);
371:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
372:   return malformed ? -EPROTO : OK;
373: }

429:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_DATA, 0, 0, 0,
430:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
431:   message.payload_address = BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
432:   message.payload_length = length;
433:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
434:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
435:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
436:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);

448: static int mb_uart_worker(int argc, char **argv)

450:   int ret;
451: 
452:   (void)argc;

494:       callback_arg = g_uart.callback_arg;

497:       if (callback != NULL)

153: static u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)
154: {
155: 	u8    crc = 0x00;
156: 
157: #if MB_UART_CRC8_ENABLE
158: 	for (u16 i = 0; i < len; i++)
159: 	{
160: 		crc = crc8_table[crc ^ data_buf[i]];
161: 	}
162: #endif
163: 
164: 	return (crc);
165: }

203: static bool mb_uart_validate_command(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb,
204: 				     mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd, bool data)
205: {
206: 	if (uart_cmd->resvd || uart_cmd->mb_cmd.param3)
207: 		return false;
208: 
209: 	if (data)
210: 	{
211: 		if (uart_cmd->cmd_buff != chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff ||
212: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len < 1 ||
213: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > UART_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
214: 			return false;
215: 		return uart_cmd->crc8 == cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff,
216: 							 uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	return uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL && uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0 &&
220: 		uart_cmd->crc8 == 0;
221: }

223: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
224: {
225: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
226: 
227: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
228: 
229: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
230: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
231: 
232: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
233: 	{
234: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
235: 	}
236: 	else
237: 	{
238: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
239: 	}
240: 
241: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
242: 	{
243: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
244: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
245: 		tx_fail = 1;
246: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
250: 	{
251: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
252: 		tx_fail = 1;
253: 
254: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
255: 	}
256: 
257: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
258: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
259: 	#endif
260: 
261: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
262: 
263: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
264: 
265: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
266: 	{
267: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
268: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
269: 	}
270: 	else
271: 	{
272: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
273: 
274: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
275: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
276: 
277: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
278: 		{
279: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
280: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
281: 		}
282: 		else
283: 		{
284: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
285: 
286: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
287: 			{
288: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
289: 			}
290: 
291: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 
295: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
296: 
297: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
298: 	{
299: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
300: 	}
301: 
302: rx_isr_data_xit:
303: 
304: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
305: 	{
306: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
307: 	}
308: 
309: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
310: 
311: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
312: 
313: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
314: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
315: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
316: 	 */
317: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
318: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
319: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
320: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
321: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
322: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
323: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
324: 
325: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
326: 	{
327: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
328: 		{
329: 			/* trigger send! */
330: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
331: 		}
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	return;
335: }

337: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
338: {
339: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
340: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
341: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
342: 
343: 	if (!invalid)
344: 		chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
345: 	else
346: 	{
347: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
348: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
349: 	}
350: 
351: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
352: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
353: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
354: 	 */
355: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
356: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
357: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
358: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
359: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
360: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
361: 
362: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
363: 	{
364: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
365: 		{
366: 			/* trigger send! */
367: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
368: 		}
369: 	}
370: 
371: 	return;
372: }

374: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
375: {
376: 	/* The response carries the current RTS state, but it cannot replace an
377: 	 * outstanding ACK-pool fence.
378: 	 */
379: 	if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req)
380: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
381: 
382: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
383: 	{
384: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
385: 	}
386: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
387: 	{
388: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
389: 	}
390: 	else
391: 	{
392: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
393: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
394: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
395: 		 */
396: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
397: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
398: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
399: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
400: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
401: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
402: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
403: 	}
404: 
405: 	return;
406: }

408: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
409: {
410: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
411: 
412: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
413: 
414: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
415: 
416: 	if ((ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) ||
417: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
418: 	{
419: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
420: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
421: 		return;
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
425: 
426: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
427: 	{
428: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
429: 	}
430: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
431: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
432: 	{
433: 		tx_fail = 1;
434: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
435: 	}
436: 	else
437: 	{
438: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
439: 	}
440: 
441: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
442: 	{
443: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
444: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
445: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
446: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
447: 	}
448: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
449: 	{
450: 		chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 0;
451: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
452: 		{
453: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
454: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
455: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
456: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
457: 		}
458: 	}
459: 
460: 	if (tx_fail)
461: 	{
462: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
463: 		{
464: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
465: 			{
466: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
467: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
468: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
469: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
470: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
471: 			}
472: 			else
473: 			{
474: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
475: 			}
476: 		}
477: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
478: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
479: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
480: 		if (chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
481: 		{
482: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
483: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
484: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
485: 		}
486: 		else
487: 		{
488: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
489: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
490: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
491: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
492: 		}
493: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
494: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
495: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
496: 		return;
497: 	}
498: 
499: 	/* try next Tx. */
500: 
501: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
502: 
503: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
504: 	{
505: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
506: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
507: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
508: 	}
509: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
510: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
511: 
512: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
513: 	{
514: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
515: 	}
516: 
517: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
518: 	{
519: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
520: 	}
521: 
522: 	return;
523: }

525: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
526: {
527: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
528: 	{
529: 		u8 peer = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
530: 
531: 		if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req &&
532: 			bk_mailbox_ack_slots_used((mailbox_endpoint_t)peer) >=
533: 			MB_UART_ACK_FENCE_WATERMARK)
534: 		{
535: 			chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 1;
536: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
537: 		}
538: 	}
539: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT)
540: 	{
541: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
542: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
543: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
544: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
545: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
546: 	}
547: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED)
548: 	{
549: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
550: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
551: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
552: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
553: 	}
554: 	else
555: 	{
556: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
557: 		{
558: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
559: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
560: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
561: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
562: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
563: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
564: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
565: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
566: 		}
567: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
568: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
569: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
570: 		chnl_cb->link_state = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT ?
571: 			MB_UART_LINK_ABORTING : MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
572: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET;
573: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
574: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
575: 		else
576: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
577: 	}
578: 
579: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
580: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
581: }

583: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
584: {
585: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
586: 
587: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
588: 		return BK_OK;
589: 
590: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
591: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
592: 	chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
593: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
594: 
595: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
596: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
597: 
598: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) ||
599: 		(chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
600: 	{
601: 		return BK_FAIL;
602: 	}
603: 
604: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
605: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
606: 	{
607: 		return ret_code;
608: 	}
609: 
610: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
611: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);
612: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
613: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_channel_event);
614: 
615: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
616: 
617: 	return BK_OK;
618: }

620: static bk_err_t mb_uart_deinit(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)

623: 		return BK_OK;

628: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, NULL);

630: 	mb_chnl_close(chnl_id);

632: 	chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback = NULL;
633: 	chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback = NULL;
634: 
635: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 0;
636: 
637: 	return BK_OK;

640: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
641: {
642: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
643: 
644: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
645: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
646: 
647: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
648: 	{
649: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
650: 	}
651: 
652: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
653: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
654: 
655: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
656: 	{
657: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
658: 	}
659: 	else
660: 	{
661: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
662: 	}
663: 
664: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
665: 	{
666: 		return BK_FAIL;
667: 	}
668: 
669: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
670: 	{
671: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
672: 	}
673: 
674: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
675: 	{
676: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
677: 	}
678: 	else
679: 	{
680: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
681: 
682: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
683: 		{
684: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
685: 		}
686: 		else
687: 		{
688: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
689: 
690: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);

694: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;

701: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
702: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
703: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
704: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);

706: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);

708: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
709: 	{
710: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = cpy_len;

790: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
791: {
792: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
793: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
794: 
795: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
796: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
797: 
798: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
799: 	{
800: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
801: 	}
802: 	else
803: 	{
804: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
805: 	}
806: 
807: 	wr_len = data_len;
808: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
809: 		wr_len = rem_len;
810: 
811: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
812: 	{
813: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
814: 	}
815: 	else
816: 	{
817: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
818: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
819: 
820: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
821: 		{
822: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
823: 		}
824: 		else
825: 		{
826: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
827: 
828: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
829: 		}
830: 	}
831: 
832: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
833: 
834: 	/* trigger send! */
835: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
836: 
837: 	return wr_len;

840: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
841: {
842: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
843: 
844: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
845: 		return 0;
846: 
847: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
848: 
849: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
850: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
851: 
852: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
853: 	{
854: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
855: 	}
856: 	else
857: 	{
858: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
859: 	}
860: 
861: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
862: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
863: 		rd_len = buf_len;
864: 
865: 	if(rd_len == 0)
866: 	{
867: 		return 0;
868: 	}
869: 
870: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
871: 	{
872: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
873: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
874: 	}
875: 	else
876: 	{
877: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
878: 
879: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
880: 		{
881: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
882: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
883: 		}
884: 		else
885: 		{
886: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
887: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
888: 			{
889: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
890: 			}
891: 
892: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
893: 		}
894: 	}
895: 
896: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
897: 
898: 	/* rts assert...... */
899: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
900: 	{
901: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
902: 		{
903: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
904: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
905: 		}
906: 	}
907: 
908: 	return rd_len;
909: 
910: }

230: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
231: {
232: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
233: 
234: 	while (1)
235: 	{
236: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
237: 		bk_err_t ret;
238: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
239: 
240: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
241: 		{
242: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
243: 			return;
244: 		}
245: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
246: 		ack_sending = 1;
247: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
248: 
249: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
250: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
251: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
252: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
253: 		{
254: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
255: 			ack_sending = 0;
256: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
257: 			return;
258: 		}
259: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
260: 		ack_count--;
261: 		ack_sending = 0;
262: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
263: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
264: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
265: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
266: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
267: 	}
268: }

270: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
271: {
272: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
273: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
274: 
275: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN)
276: 	{
277: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
278: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
279: 		return false;
280: 	}
281: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
282: 	entry->data = *data;
283: 	entry->destination = destination;
284: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
285: 	ack_count++;
286: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
287: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
288: 	return true;
289: }

334: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
335: {
336: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
337: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
338: 	u16 			chnl_type;
339: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
340: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
341: 
342: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
343: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
344: 
345: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
346: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
347: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
348: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
349: #endif
350: 
351: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
352: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
353: 
354: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
355: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
356: 
357: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
358: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
359: 
360: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
361: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
362: 
363: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
364: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
365: 
366: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
367: 
368: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
369: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
370: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
371: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
372: 
373: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
374: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_cmd_header = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
375: 
376: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
377: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
378: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
379: 
380: 	__DMB();
381: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
382: 
383: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
384: 
385: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
386: 
387: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
388: 	{
389: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
390: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
391: 
392: 		return ret_code;
393: 	}
394: 
395: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
396: 
397: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
398: 
399: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
400: 	{
401: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
402: 	}
403: 
404: 	return BK_OK;
405: }

407: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
408: {
409: 	u8		log_chnl;
410: 	u8		ret_code;
411: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
412: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
413: 
414: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
415: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
416: 
417: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
418: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
419: 	{
420: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
421: 
422: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
423: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
424: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
425: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
426: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
427: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
428: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
429: 		{
430: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
431: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
432: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
433: 			return;
434: 		}
435: 
436: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
437: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
438: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
439: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
440: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
441: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
442: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
443: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
444: 		{
445: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
446: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
447: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
448: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
449: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
450: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
451: 			{
452: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
453: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
454: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
455: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
456: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
457: 			}
458: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
459: 		}
460: 		else
461: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
462: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
463: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
464: 		return;
465: 	}
466: 
467: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
468: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
469: 
470: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
471: 
472: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
473: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
474: 		return;
475: 	}
476: 
477: 
478: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
479: 	{
480: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
481: 		return;
482: 	}
483: 
484: 
485: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
486: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
487: 		return;
488: 	}
489: 
490: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
491: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_header = ack_ptr->hdr.data;
492: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_data1 = ack_ptr->data1;
493: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
494: 
495: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
496: 	{
497: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
498: 		return;
499: 	}
500: 
501: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
502: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
503: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
504: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
505: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
506: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
507: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
508: 	{
509: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
510: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
511: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
512: 		return;
513: 	}
514: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
515: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
516: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
517: 
518: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
519: 
520: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
521: 	{
522: 		/* clear following header members. */
523: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
524: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
525: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
526: 
527: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
528: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
529: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
530: 	} else {
531: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
535: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
536: 	{
537: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
538: 		return;
539: 	}
540: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
541: 	{
542: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
543: 			break;
544: 	}
545: 
546: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
547: 	{
548: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
549: 		return;
550: 	}
551: 
552: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
553: 
554: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
555: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
556: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
557: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
558: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
559: 
560: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
561: 
562: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
563: 	{
564: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
565: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
566: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
567: 	}
568: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
569: 
570: 	return;
571: 
572: }

574: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
575: {
576: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
577: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
578: 
579: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
580: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
581: 
582: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
583: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
584: 
585: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
586: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
587: 
588: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
589: 
590: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
591: 		return;
592: 
593: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
594: 		return;
595: 
596: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
597: 		return;
598: 
599: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
600: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
601: 
602: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
603: 
604: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
605: 	{
606: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
607: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
608: 
609: 		return;
610: 	}
611: 
612: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
613: 	{
614: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
615: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
616: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
617: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
618: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
619: 
620: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
621: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
622: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
623: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
624: 	}
625: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
626: 	{
627: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
628: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
629: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
630: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
631: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
632: 
633: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
634: 
635: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
636: 	}
637: 	else
638: 	{
639: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
640: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
641: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
642: 	}
643: 
644: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
645: 	{
646: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
647: 		return;
648: 	}
649: 
650: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
651: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
652: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
653: 
654: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
655: 	{
656: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
657: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
658: 		return;
659: 	}
660: 	return;
661: }
662: 
663: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
664: {
665: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
666: 
667: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
668: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
669: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
670: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
671: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
672: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
673: 
674: 	/*
675: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
676: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
677: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
678: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
679: 	 */
680: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
681: 	{
682: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
683: 	}
684: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
685: 	{
686: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
687: 	}
688: }

690: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
691: {
692: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
693: 
694: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
695: 
696: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
697: 
698: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
699: 
700: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
701: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
702: 
703: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
704: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
705: 
706: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
707: 
708: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
709: 	{
710: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
711: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
712: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
713: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
714: 
715: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
716: 
717: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
718: 		{
719: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
720: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
721: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
722: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
723: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
724: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
725: 
726: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
727: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
728: 			}
729: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
730: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
731: 			return ret_code;
732: 		}
733: 	}
734: 
735: 	return BK_OK;
736: }

738: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
739: 
740: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
741: {
742: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
743: 	u16 			chnl_type;
744: 
745: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
746: 
747: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
748: 
749: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
750: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
751: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
752: #endif
753: 
754: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
755: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
756: 
757: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
758: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
759: 
760: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
761: 
762: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
763: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
764: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
765: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
766: 
767: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
768: 
769: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
770: 
771: 	/*
772: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
773: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
774: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
775: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
776: 	 */
777: 	while(1)
778: 	{
779: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
780: 
781: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
782: 		{
783: 			break;
784: 		}
785: 	}
786: 
787: 	return ret_code;
788: }

791: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
792: /*
793:   * init logical chnanel module.
794:   * return:
795:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
796:   *     failed  : fail code.
797:   *
798:   */
799: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
800: {
801: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
802: 	int				i, j;
803: 
804: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
805: 
806: 	/*
807: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
808: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
809: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
810: 	 * can race here:
811: 	 *
812: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
813: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
814: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
815: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
816: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
817: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
818: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
819: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
820: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
821: 	 *
822: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
823: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
824: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
825: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
826: 	 */
827: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
828: 	{
829: 		return BK_OK;
830: 	}
831: 
832: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
833: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
834: 	{
835: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
836: 		return BK_OK;
837: 	}
838: 
839: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
840: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
841: 	ack_read = 0;
842: 	ack_write = 0;
843: 	ack_count = 0;
844: 	ack_sending = 0;
845: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
846: 	{
847: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
848: 
849: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
850: 
851: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
852: 
853: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
854: 		{
855: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
856: 		}
857: 	}
858: 
859: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
860: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
861: 	{
862: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
863: 		return ret_code;
864: 	}
865: 
866: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
867: 
868: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
869: 	{
870: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
871: 
872: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
873: 	}
874: 
875: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
876: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
877: 
878: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
879: 
880: 	return BK_OK;
881: }

901: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)

920: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)

1008: 
1009: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1010: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
1011: 
1012: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;

1014: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1015: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))

1020: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1021: 
1022: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1023: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1024: 
1025: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1026: 
1027: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1028: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1029: 
1030: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1031: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1032: 
1033: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1034: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
1035: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t *logical_cmd = cmd_buf;
1036: 
1037: 	if (phy->recovering &&
1038: 		!(log_chnl == MB_CHNL_UART0 &&
1039: 		  logical_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND))
1040: 	{
1041: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1042: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1043: 	}
1044: 
1045: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
1046: 	{
1047: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1048: 
1049: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1050: 	}
1051: 
1052: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
1053: 
1054: 	memset(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, 0,
1055: 	       sizeof(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff));
1056: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
1057: 
1058: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
1059: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
1060: 	__DMB();
1061: 
1062: 	bk_err_t start_ret = mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
1063: 
1064: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1065: 
1066: 	return start_ret;

1154: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1155: {
1156: 	u8 phy_idx;
1157: 	u32 poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1158: 
1159: 	/* The CPU1 boot transaction may poll directly while ap_console is also
1160: 	 * scheduled.  Serialize the whole poll pass without holding the channel
1161: 	 * lock across callbacks and physical sends.
1162: 	 */
1163: 	if (s_poll_active)
1164: 	{
1165: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1166: 		return;
1167: 	}
1168: 	s_poll_active = 1;
1169: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1170: 
1171: 	bk_mailbox_poll();
1172: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
1173: 
1174: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1175: 	{
1176: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1177: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1178: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1179: 		u8 log_idx;
1180: 
1181: 		u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1182: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1183: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1184: 		{
1185: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1186: 			continue;
1187: 		}
1188: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1189: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;
1190: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1191: 
1192: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1193: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);
1194: 		if (log_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx])
1195: 			continue;
1196: 
1197: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt++;
1198: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;
1199: 		bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_idx);
1200: 		phy->recovering = 1;
1201: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
1202: 		failure.hdr.cmd = phy->tx_hdr_cmd;
1203: 		failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
1204: 		if (logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
1205: 			logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(logs[log_idx].isr_param, &failure);
1206: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx]);
1207: 		mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1208: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT);
1209: 		if (mb_phy_chnl_send_reset(phy_idx, phy->tx_log_chnl) == BK_OK)
1210: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1211: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT);
1212: 		else
1213: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1214: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED);
1215: 	}
1216: 
1217: 	poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1218: 	s_poll_active = 0;
1219: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1220: }

579: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
580: 
581: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 成功 ACK、IPC power-up 和
582: PWC boot-ready 三个条件同时成立，且`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，
583: `ap_console open`才允许进入。heartbeat timeout、AP reset/power-off 和 Mailbox
584: reset/timeout都会清除门禁并请求回退到CP CLI。使用方式：
585: 
586: ```text
587: ap_console status
588: ap_console open
589: <RAW AP NSH interaction>
590: <press Ctrl-], release it, then press .>
591: ap_console status
592: ```
593: 
594: `open`在当前 CP CLI 响应经 UART TX-complete 后生效，并清 CP parser 和 UART RX；

369: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)

371:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
372:   struct pwc_message message;
373:   unsigned int next;
374:   irqstate_t flags;
375: 
376:   if (bytes == NULL)
377:     {
378:       return;
379:     }
380: 
381:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
382:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
383:   if (next == g_tail)
384:     {
385:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
386:       return;
387:     }
388: 
389:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
390:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
391:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
392:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
393:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
394:   g_head = next;
395:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
396:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);

406:   g_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
407:   g_worker_ready = ret >= 0;
